items.title: CosmicSting attack & defense overview
items.summary: CosmicSting is a critical vulnerability affecting Magento and Adobe Commerce stores, leading to persistent backdoors and widespread compromise.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: SessionReaper is a critical bug allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain full control of a Magento or Adobe Commerce store through remote code execution.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to switch customer sessions and escalate privileges.

items.title: Adobe Security Bulletin APSB26-73
items.summary: This security update for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities, including those leading to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A high-severity stored cross-site scripting vulnerability could result in arbitrary code execution, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce B2B could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication but not administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring neither authentication nor administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability could enable a security-feature bypass, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: An incorrect authorization vulnerability could result in privilege escalation, requiring authentication and administrator privileges.

items.title: Amasty patches dozens of Magento extensions, 2 critical
items.summary: Amasty released a security update for dozens of its Magento extensions, addressing two critical vulnerabilities that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: A critical unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie on any storefront request.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API, named PolyShell, allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by bypassing validation. Adobe released a fix in Magento 2.4.9.
